mapper.select: /* WebLeavePromo01Mapper.selectDesignateTargetMeta */ SELECT U.SITE_CD AS siteCd , U.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , U.HIRE_DATE AS hireDate , M.BASE_AVAIL_TO_DATE AS baseAvailToDate FROM TB_USER U LEFT JOIN ( SELECT M1.USER_CD , M1.BASE_AVAIL_TO_DATE FROM TB_LEAVE_PROMOTION_LOG M1 WHERE M1.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND M1.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND M1.PROMO_STAGE = 'SECOND' AND M1.STATUS IN ('NOTICED', 'DESIGNATED') AND M1.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY M1.BASE_AVAIL_TO_DATE ASC, M1.PROMO_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) M ON M.USER_CD = U.USER_CD WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' LIMIT 1
